market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG has never won the Champions League and faces elite competition from Real Madrid, Manchester City, Bayern Munich, and others. A 58.5% implied probability suggests they are more likely to win than not, which is wildly unrealistic for any team in a 32+ team knockout tournament. Pre‑season odds for top clubs rarely exceed 20‑25%. My independent estimate of PSG's true chance is around 8%, leading to a massive edge on the 'No' side.
evidence_points: In the past decade, no club has been given preseason CL win odds above 30% on major betting markets.
PSG have repeatedly fallen short in knockout stages despite heavy investment, losing 5 of their last 7 quarter‑finals.
Squad parity: Real Madrid (holders), Man City, and Bayern all have comparable or superior teams and stronger CL pedigrees.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of European football power dynamics
